本当は私が全部食べるところを、お情けであんたらの分も残してあげてるんだからね！」
contexts.japanesePC: 「あんた光栄に思いなさいよね！！　本当は私が全部食べるところを、お情けであんたらの分も残してあげてるんだからね！」

ホールの天上の巨大なシャンデリアがバリバリと帯電して、そこから凄まじい紫の落雷が落ちる…！
それは、真下の女に直撃し、消し炭にしてしまうはずだった。

ベアトが黄金の煙管を振り上げると、

contexts.WH: As Beato waved her gold pipe, the massive chandelier hanging in the hall was electrocuted, and from that, a terrible purple thunderbolt fell...!
contexts.MG:
As Beato waved her gold pipe,
the massive chandelier hanging in the hall was electrocuted, and from that, a terrible purple thunderbolt fell...!
It should have been a direct hit on the girl right below it, turning her to ash.
contexts.UP:
Beato raised her gold pipe high,
and the massive chandelier hanging in the hall crackled with electricity, and from that fell an almighty purple thunderbolt...!
It was a direct hit on the woman right below it, and should have turned her to ash.
contexts.note: MG retains electrocuted; UP restores electrical charging.

findings.sourceReading: 帯電 describes accumulating an electrical charge before the lightning discharge.
findings.alternative: Electrocuted is sometimes used loosely for shocked, but still describes injury by electricity rather than the source’s charge buildup in an object.
findings.sourceNote: Original Witch Hunt is compared with the original-PC Japanese embedded in the historical patches. findings.description: WH says it was worth having the newcomer show up uninvited, rather than acknowledging that her capacity explains her daring intrusion.

contexts.japanese:
「ほぉ…！！
飛び入りするだけのことはある…！！
聞こう！　名を名乗れ！！」
contexts.japanesePC: 「ほぉ…！！　飛び入りするだけのことはある…！！　聞こう！　名を名乗れ！！」
contexts.japanesePS3:
「ほぉ…！！
飛び入りするだけのことはある…！！
聞こう！　名を名乗れ！！」
contexts.WH: "Hoh...!!  So it was worth having you show up uninvited...!!  Tell me!  Say your name!!"
contexts.MG:
"Hoh...!!
So, your sudden appearance here wasn't just a fluke...!!
Tell me! State your name!!"
contexts.UP:
"Hoh...!!
I see you have what it takes to show up uninvited...!!
Tell me! Say your name!!"
contexts.note: MG’s not just a fluke reasonably acknowledges the capacity explaining the intrusion; UP states that capacity explicitly.

findings.sourceReading: 飛び入りするだけのことはある appraises the newcomer as having the ability befitting or justifying her uninvited entry, after surviving lightning.
findings.alternative: Both convey impressed acknowledgment, but worth having you show up evaluates benefit to the host rather than the newcomer’s qualifications.

findings.description: WH renders 何でも as No matter what, replacing a hearsay introduction with an unconditional qualifier.

contexts.japanese: 「何でも、ツンツンと残虐を尽くした後に程よくヘタれてデレて見せると、好感度ってヤツが大幅アップするんだろー？」
contexts.japanesePC: 何でも、ツンツンと残虐を尽くした後に程よくヘタれてデレて見せると、好感度ってヤツが大幅アップするんだろー？
contexts.japanesePS3: 「何でも、ツンツンと残虐を尽くした後に程よくヘタれてデレて見せると、好感度ってヤツが大幅アップするんだろー？」
contexts.WH: No matter what, after acting bad-tempered and exploring the depths of cruelty, by acting properly incompetent and soft, you get a massive rise on that goodwill meter thing, ri-ght?
contexts.MG: "Apparently, if you start out all hostile and needlessly brutal, then turn incompetent and soft at just the right moment, you can spark a huge bump on your affection meter, riiight?"
contexts.UP: "I hear, after acting {ruby:tsuntsun:bad‐tempered and exploring the depths of cruelty, if you act properly incompetent and {ruby:dere:soft, you can get a massive rise on that goodwill meter thing, riiight?"
contexts.note: MG Apparently and UP I hear restore hearsay.

findings.sourceReading: 何でも here introduces something reportedly learned about acting harsh then weak and affectionate to increase favorable impressions, consistent with the following heard/studied references.
findings.alternative: The same strategy remains described and later hearing survives, but no matter what supplies an unsupported unconditional scope instead of apparently or from what I hear.

findings.description: WH gives the literal quoted tears please rather than the sentimental tearjerker appeal that made Battler fall for it.

contexts.japanese: 「そうしたらお前、案の定、お涙頂戴でコロリだよ！！」
contexts.japanesePC: そうしたらお前、案の定、お涙頂戴でコロリだよ！！
contexts.japanesePS3: 「そうしたらお前、案の定、お涙頂戴でコロリだよ！！」
contexts.WH: And for you, just as expected, it was 'tears please', and you're down!!
contexts.MG: "And for you, just as expected, it was "tears please", and you're down!!
contexts.UP: "And I tried it out, and just as expected, it was "tears please", and you're down!!"
contexts.note: Both retain tears please rather than the sentimental tearjerker appeal.

findings.sourceReading: お涙頂戴 names a contrived sentimental appeal or tearjerker, paired with コロリ describing his being taken in.
findings.alternative: Earlier sentimentality and the named strategy supply context, but the literal phrase obscures the mechanism explicitly named in the sentence.

……でも少しだけ感謝するわ。
……こうして、みんなに会わせてくれて」
contexts.japanesePC: ……でも少しだけ感謝するわ。……こうして、みんなに会わせてくれて。」
contexts.japanesePS3:
「えぇ、わかってるわ。
誰があんたなんかと遊ぶものですか。

contexts.WH: ......But I will thank you a bit.  ......For bringing everyone together like this."

...But I will thank you just a little.

findings.sourceReading: みんなに会わせてくれて refers to causing or allowing the speaker to meet the others, continuing her envy and desire to join them.
findings.alternative: A reunion requires bringing people together, but the English removes her personal encounter as the reason for gratitude.

findings.description: UP asserts that the lightning was a direct hit, whereas Japanese places the direct hit and reduction to ash under expectation.

contexts.japanese:
それは、真下の女に直撃し、消し炭にしてしまうはずだった。
しかし、……髪の毛一本、焦がせていない。
contexts.japanesePS3:
それは、真下の女に直撃し、消し炭にしてしまうはずだった。
しかし、……髪の毛一本、焦がせていない。
contexts.MG:
It should have been a direct hit on the girl right below it, turning her to ash.
However, ...not a single hair was singed.
contexts.UP:
It was a direct hit on the woman right below it, and should have turned her to ash.
However, ......not a single hair was singed.

findings.sourceReading: The strike should have hit the woman directly and reduced her to ash, yet not even a hair was singed.
findings.alternative: The visible strike may suggest contact, but the next sentence confirms only absence of injury. Japanese hazu datta scopes both coordinated actions; MG and original WH PC135853 retain should have been a direct hit.

findings.description: MG substitutes an icicle for needle ice and separates truth from the explicitly identified spring in the closing metaphor.

contexts.japanese: 「あんたなんて、真実という春に怯える霜柱でしかないことを教えてやるッ！
contexts.japanesePS3: 「あんたなんて、真実という春に怯える霜柱でしかないことを教えてやるッ！
contexts.MG: "I'll show you that before the truth, you're like an icicle scared of the coming spring!
contexts.UP: "I'll teach you that you're no more than needle ice, scared of the spring of truth!

findings.sourceReading: She is only needle ice afraid of the spring that is truth.
findings.alternative: Both ice forms melt in spring, retaining the broad threat, but the ground-grown ice image and identification of truth with spring change. Original PC Japanese136205 and WH136206 preserve the source image; UP restores needle ice and spring of truth.
